Orders & Delivery: Thank you for reaching out about your order! We'd be happy to help with any questions regarding order status, delivery times, or modifications. Please share your order number and we'll look into it right away.
Product Quality: We sincerely appreciate your feedback regarding product quality — it helps us maintain the high standards our customers expect. If you experienced any issue with freshness or taste, we'd like to make it right. Please provide your order details so we can arrange a replacement or refund.
Custom Requests: We love bringing your custom creations to life! For personalized cakes, pastries, or specialty items, we typically require 48–72 hours advance notice depending on complexity. Please share the details of your request including size, flavors, and any design preferences, and we'll provide a quote promptly.
Pricing & Billing: Thank you for contacting us regarding pricing or billing. We're happy to clarify any charges or provide pricing details for our menu items. If you believe there is a billing discrepancy, please share your receipt or order number and we'll investigate immediately.
Allergies & Ingredients: Your safety is our top priority. We take allergen concerns very seriously and can provide detailed ingredient lists for any of our products upon request. Please let us know which items you're inquiring about, and we'll share the complete allergen and ingredient information.
